additional_info.subject: RE: ID0411013-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002180] Connectors unavailable CRM:00921001609
additional_info.body:
Hi
Chloë D'hose,
We have analyzed the logs for all the chargers mentioned in the webform, and the outlets are out of order due to an 'Error Polling CoAP,' which means the internal communication with SECC was lost for a brief period of time. Our charger will reconnect to SECC within 5 seconds. While SECC is not reachable, an 'Outlet Out of Order' flag will be active and will be cleared once the charger reconnects to SECC. We have observed that this issue does not occur frequently, for example, within a 3-hour period, it happens only once or twice. If this issue persists for longer duration of time or continuous of day or two, we recommend updating the EcoG firmware if it is not already updated to the latest version. The concerned team is already addressing this issue, and it will be fixed in the upcoming firmware versions of the Sicharge charger.
I hope there are no further queries related to this. If not, shall we proceed with closing this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
